shots.camera: The camera pushes in slowly toward the gate.
shots.action: Rain falls through the lantern light and the woman in the doorway stands still.

shots.camera: The camera keeps moving toward the arch.
shots.action: She lowers her spear until it touches the wet stones and straightens up.

shots.camera: The camera moves in on her face.
shots.action: She blinks once and her eyes move to the left as rain runs down her cheek.
The man in the rust-red coat walks down the road toward the gate, one step after another.

shots.camera: The camera tracks sideways with him.
shots.action: He stops walking, lifts his head and looks up at the lantern above the gate.
